messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 46(3)

Article 46 Formal non-compliance. 3. Where the non-compliance referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 persists, the Member State concerned shall take all appropriate measures to restrict or prohibit the product within the scope of this Regulation concerned being made available on the market or ensure that it is recalled or withdrawn from the market.

response.text:
Member State concerned | shall take all appropriate measures to restrict or prohibit | the product within the scope of this Regulation being made available on the market | where the non-compliance referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 persists | "the Member State concerned shall take all appropriate measures to restrict or prohibit the product within the scope of this Regulation concerned being made available on the market"
Member State concerned | shall ensure recall or withdrawal | the product within the scope of this Regulation from the market | where the non-compliance referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 persists | "or ensure that it is recalled or withdrawn from the market"
